error.google: Ntitwabashije kukwinjiza dukoresheje Google. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa ukoreshe imeri n'ijambobanga.
error.google_cancelled: Kwinjira ukoresheje Google byahagaritswe. Ushobora kongera kugerageza, cyangwa gukoresha imeri n'ijambobanga.
error.google_unverified: Google ivuga ko iyi mimero itemejwe, ntidushobora kuyikoresha.

exists.title: Iyi mimero isanzwe ifite konti
exists.text: Injira aho kuyifungura. Niba wiyandikishije ukoresheje Google, hitamo Komeza ukoresheje Google. Niba wibagiwe ijambobanga, ushobora guhitamo irishya.
exists.pendingText: Waratangiye gufungura konti ukoresheje iyi mimero, ariko ntiremezwa. Twohereje ihuza rishya ryo kwemeza. Rimara amasaha 24.

delete.emailLabel: Andika imeri yawe kugira ngo wemeze
delete.emailHint: Konti yawe yafunguwe ukoresheje Google, ntifite ijambobanga.

errors.emailMismatch: Iyi si imeri ya konti yawe.
